subject: Invoice 7431 — payment attempted but payee mismatch / bank verify
messages:
From: Claire Morgan <claire.morgan@vectrahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment attempt for Invoice 7431 — bank returned

Hi Irene,

Our AP team attempted to send payment for Invoice 7431 today via ACH, but the payment was returned by our bank with a 'payee name mismatch' reason. I've attached the remittance stub and our initiation confirmation.

We paid to the account details on the invoice (account name: Redwood Inference Inc.). Our bank's reconciliation shows the beneficiary returned as 'Redwood Inference, LLC' — a slight name variance. Before we retry (wire or virtual card), can you confirm the correct legal payee and whether you can accept a wire (same-day) if we re-initiate?

We want to avoid multiple retries that create fees on our side. Proposed options:
- Confirm payee name on your side and we'll retry ACH next week.
- If name mismatch persists, we'll send a wire (we can do that by Fri 5/8).
- Or provide a virtual card link and we'll pay by card (we'll need a PO confirmation).

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can close this out.

Thanks,
Claire
Accounts Payable
Vectra Health

Attachments: remittance_stub_7431.png (image), invoice_7431.pdf (pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Morgan <claire.morgan@vectrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment attempt for Invoice 7431 — bank returned

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and for the attachment.

Quick answers: our legal entity for that invoice should be "Redwood Inference, Inc." (no LLC). Sorry for the confusion — the invoice generator defaulted to an older template.

Before you retry ACH, could you confirm the exact beneficiary name your bank is sending? Banks are notoriously strict on spacing/commas. If your system will keep sending "Redwood Inference, LLC" it will fail again.

If it's easier for you to wire, we can accept a same-day wire. Wire details (masked) are provided here: Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc. — Bank: Pacific West Bank — Routing: XXX-XXX-XXX — Account ending: **** 4821.

Options from our side:
- If you prefer ACH, please update beneficiary to "Redwood Inference, Inc." and retry next Tue 5/5.
- If you want to wire, confirm and we'll mark the invoice as 'in-process' to avoid double-payment.
- If you want virtual card, Ben can set that up — Ben, can you create a single-use card for $28,400 and share the link? Also confirm PO match for the card.

Claire, if you need a corrected invoice PDF stamped with the legal name, I can resend it (marissa, please attach corrected invoice when I confirm).

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Claire and team — looping in to propose the fastest path.

We can issue a virtual card immediately if Vectra's AP can accept card payment. Virtual card will avoid ACH name-matching problems and is usually cleared same-day by our payment processor. If you'd like to go this route I need:
- PO or approval code to tie to the charge (so we can reconcile).
- Confirmation that any card processing fees (if applicable) are acceptable; Redwood can absorb small processing fees for one-off cases but would like confirmation.

If you prefer a wire, we can accept that too; please send the wire advice when sent and we'll mark the invoice in our ledger.

Marissa, can you please prepare a corrected invoice PDF with 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' in the payee field? I will also create the virtual-card request if Claire confirms.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick update from AP.

1) Our bank confirms the returned ACH was sent to beneficiary name 'Redwood Inference, LLC' (exact match). That explains the rejection. They can re-initiate once we have a corrected invoice.
2) We are happy to pay by wire instead to avoid another failed ACH. Planning to originate wire tomorrow 5/6 EOD (US PST) — please confirm you can receive wire and we will send the advice.
3) Vectra prefers not to pay card for this vendor due to internal procurement limits, so virtual card is a no-go this time.

Ben/Marissa: please send the corrected invoice PDF and I'll share the wire advice once the wire is sent. We'll include our PO# VCT-8842 on the wire notes.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Claire Morgan
AP Lead, Vectra Health
